name: demoshop-rag
description: A learning-focused RAG API for the fictional DemoShop store.

scripts.eval:offline: npm run evaluation:build && mkdir -p evaluation/results && PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=true PROMPTFOO_SAFE_MODE=true promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --env-file .env --no-cache --no-share
scripts.eval:smoke: npm run evaluation:build && mkdir -p evaluation/results && PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=true PROMPTFOO_SAFE_MODE=true promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --env-file .env --no-cache --no-share --filter-first-n 3
scripts.eval:validate: npm run evaluation:build && PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=true PROMPTFOO_SAFE_MODE=true promptfoo validate config -c promptfooconfig.yaml --env-file .env
